title: Jarren Garcia to perform at 31st Asian TV Awards in Vietnam
summary: Star Magic artist Jarren Garcia flew to Vietnam early Wednesday morning, Nov. 11, to perform as a featured artist representing the Philippines at the 31st Asian Television Awards.
